svg.aria-label: A run sends one request per item. Each request holds the task's instructions and that one item, nothing from earlier calls, so a-02's request knows nothing of a-01's answer. Each answer is appended to labels.jsonl and the exact request and response are kept by hash. Re-running skips a-03, which this task version already labelled.
